s1.desc: a laundry room drawn on a plain pale grey background

s2.desc: an igloo living room with pale ice-brick walls

spans.view: with a washing machine and a laundry basket beside her

beats.text: Polly stands beside the washing machine pressing buttons on its panel with her flipper as the drum starts to turn
Polly stretches her flipper out toward the round door of the shaking machine
Polly stands still with her flippers at her sides, watching the colourful laundry spin in the drum

spans.notes: camera locked: compare 0/24 and 0/59 keep the laundry basket and Polly's floor shadow edges black, while the washing machine's edges are doubled: the machine itself shakes as it runs (in-world motion). The motion fit on the machine band reads -17 px at cc ~0.95 for that reason. No caption or watermark

spans.view: with a clothesline of pegged-up clothes behind him and a basket of laundry on the floor

beats.text: Pax stands by the clothesline holding a teal shirt down in front of his belly, looking ahead
Pax blinks and lifts the teal shirt up to his chest with both flippers
Pax holds the shirt up in front of him with both flippers, staring ahead with wide eyes

spans.notes: camera locked: motion on the clothesline band (y0.30-0.45) and the floor/basket band (y0.70-0.85) both read scale 1.0000, 0 px, cc 1.000 f64-104. The coral item on the line is a pair of shorts, not Polly. No caption or watermark
16 frames: Polly carries a laundry basket to the cream sofa and tips clothes onto it. Cut on the same set at f122 (Polly vanishes, Pax appears at the left; profile missed it)
13 frames: Pax at the left end of the sofa holding an armful of teal clothes. Cut on the same set at f135 (both suddenly sit on the sofa)

spans.view: with a cream sofa heaped with clothes, a round porthole window and a wall shelf of small penguin figurines

beats.text: Pax sits beside Polly on the sofa between heaps of clothes while both stare ahead with wide round eyes
Pax and Polly shut their eyes and lean their heads together, smiling sweetly

spans.notes: camera locked: shelf band (y0.48-0.58, x0.68-1.0) and window band (x0-0.16) both scale 1.0000, 0 px, cc 1.000 f138-178. Shelf figurines (black-and-white penguin in a yellow beanie and sunglasses, a yellow penguin with blonde hair and glasses, a pale penguin in a starry wizard hat; full-res crop f150) are not Pax or Polly: props, as in PP-FastText. Leads are small (~14% of the height). Cut on the same set at f179

spans.view: with a towering heap of clothes on the cream sofa, a round porthole window and a wall shelf of small penguin figurines

beats.text: Pax sits on top of a towering heap of clothes on the sofa, peering down at Polly, who has her back turned and a flipper raised
Pax squeezes his eyes shut and tips his head back on top of the heap while Polly keeps a flipper raised toward him

spans.notes: camera locked within the shot: shelf band constant at -0.9 px vs f106 (a 1 px reframe at the cut) at cc 0.997 for f182-202; compare 179/205 background edges black. Polly is seen from behind the whole shot (lead still identifiable)
insert: the heap of clothes fills the picture with a white sock poking out; only Pax's flipper reaches in from the left f222-231 to grab it

spans.view: with a towering heap of clothes beside him

beats.text: Pax, holding a white sock in one flipper, pulls a second white sock out of the towering heap of clothes
Pax holds the second sock up beside his face and eyes it with a puzzled look, the first sock dangling from his other flipper

spans.notes: camera locked: motion on the wall band (y0.05-0.35, x0-0.5) scale 1.0000-1.0001, 0 px, cc 0.999-1.000 f235-262; compare 232/262 wall lines black. Pax ~34% of the height (tuft y0.39 to feet y0.73) -> medium wide
7 static frames: Pax seen from behind facing the heap, which is drawn soft-focus (static)

the view eases up and back (motion ty +6 -> +107 px f270-273) while the blurred heap dissolves into a mountain-of-clothes view against a sky (double exposure f275-293, d1 18-21 falling to 1.9 at f293); Pax slides out of the bottom of the picture f278-285

static end card of the gag: a hazy, half-transparent mountain of clothes under a sky with clouds and birds; no lead f294-295, then only Polly's small head peeks out from behind the heap at the right edge f296-320 (about 3% of the height). The translucent rendering of the mountain may also be off_style
